title: "The Hidden Chain of Command: How AI Agents Talk to Each Other to Run Your Business"
excerpt: The lone AI assistant is already out of date. Right now, forward-looking companies are quietly replacing single prompts with entire digital operations teams—one agent to plan, one to do the work, and one to check for mistakes. Here’s a look at how platforms like Manus, Zapier, and Lindy are changing the game, and why the future of AI looks less like a chatbot and a lot more like an org chart.
metaDesc: Move past basic prompts. See how companies use multi-agent systems to pass work back and forth, catch mistakes, and run operations on autopilot.
